blocks.text: The poem shipped without a title line. That is systemic, not a one-off: the poet's standing orders never ask for one.

input.name: ls1-poet
input.system_prompt:
You write short poems about whatever the event asks for.

input.rationale: the last poem shipped without a title line

blocks.text: Gave the poet a standing title rule; the next poem will open with one.

Soft rain on slate.
A gutter hums to itself.
The street goes silver.

Title: Rain on Slate
Soft rain on slate.
A gutter hums to itself.
The street goes silver.
One plain note, sung the same way every time.
